maintenance_items.description: Diesel engines put more stress on oil. Use low-ash oil (C3/C4) to protect the DPF.
Diesel engines use compression ignition; they have no spark plugs.

maintenance_items.label: Fuel filter
maintenance_items.description: The fuel filter traps water and contaminants. A clogged filter causes power loss and hard starting.

maintenance_items.label: EGR cleaning
maintenance_items.description: Diesel peculiarity: the EGR valve accumulates soot over time. Cleaning restores engine efficiency and reduces emissions.

maintenance_items.label: DPF / FAP cleaning
maintenance_items.description: The diesel particulate filter accumulates ash. If not regenerated properly, it may need professional cleaning or replacement.

maintenance_items.label: Glow plugs
maintenance_items.description: Glow plugs preheat the combustion chamber for cold starts. A failed plug causes misfiring and white smoke.
